thread:
alex m: quick flag — I'm seeing different semantics for "quota" vs "partial degrade" across services. SDKs interpret 202 vs 429 differently and our console groups them oddly.

priya s: example payloads?

alex m: service A returns:

```json
{"error":{"code":"QUOTA_EXHAUSTED","http_status":429}}
```

service B returns a soft-degrade:

```json
{"status":"partial","http_status":202,"details":"best-effort; truncated response"}
```

marco: that's the problem — both indicate capacity issues but client UX should see one canonical "throttle/quota" bucket.

jen l: proposal: add a compact classification header + body field called status_bucket with stable IDs. header X-RWD-STATUS-BKT and X-RWD-STATUS-V. bucket values: QUOTA, THROTTLE, PARTIAL_DEGRADE, SERVER_ERROR, BAD_REQUEST.

sam ops: telemetry loves enums. we'll ingest X-RWD-STATUS-BKT as tag and map buckets to metric retention. propose numeric bucket codes too for legacy indexers: BKT=1..5.

priya s: requirement: include retry_after when applicable and a short human hint with link to runbook. e.g. "retry_after":30 and "hint":"Quota exhausted; request more capacity — https://console.redwood.ai/runbooks/quota"

alex m: sample canonical response:

```json
{
  "error":{
    "status_bucket":"QUOTA",
    "code":"QUOTA_EXHAUSTED",
    "http_status":429,
    "retry_after":30,
    "hint":"Quota exhausted. See runbook.",
    "trace_id":"rwd:01f..."
  }
}
```

marco: migration plan idea:
- gateway shim emits X-RWD-STATUS-BKT and polyfills error.status_bucket in body when missing
- services update their handlers to set bucket explicitly
- SDKs read header first, then body
- telemetry rules: 100% sample QUOTA, 100% SERVER_ERROR, 5% other 4xx
- console: Errors Explorer groups by status_bucket and exposes sample traces

jen l: acceptance tests: every route that returns 429 for quota must include header X-RWD-STATUS-BKT=QUOTA and X-RWD-STATUS-V=1. SDK unit tests should assert header precedence.

sam ops: I'll add ingestion alerts for any 429 without bucket after 1 week in canary. also emit metric polyfill.count so we can monitor shim coverage.

priya s: UX ask: console badges must include text (e.g., "Quota") in addition to color for accessibility. Also allow product to search by status_bucket in the explorer.

alex m: timeline: RFC this week, gateway shim in canary next Tuesday, 14d canary, then staged prod. deprecation window for old-only shapes = 45 days after full rollout.

marco: can we make bucket values stable strings? yes. bikeshed header to X-RWD-ERR-BKT or X-RWD-STATUS-BKT? i'm fine with STATUS.

jen l: also add a flag in SDKs that logs a warning when it sees unknown bucket values so integrators can report.

deploy-bot: gateway shim deploy scheduled: 2024-11-05T10:00Z

sam ops: i'll prepare dashboards and the ingestion mapping. will coordinate with billing team to ensure QUOTA sampling covers reconciliation needs.

alex m: thanks — i'll draft RFC and include sample queries for the console data explorer: group by X-RWD-STATUS-BKT, count by tenant.

priya s: tagging @all: please review RFC within 48h.

jen l: on it. :eyes:

marco: will review too.

alex m: quick win if this lands — should reduce false alerts and make console filtering much clearer.

priya s: agreed. thanks everyone.
